activity_summary: Reported late-August rebranding of a server previously used by Babuk.
Data attributed to a Thai IT-service-provider victim is hosted on the wyyad server.
German printing-company data leak observed on Groove website at time of writing.
One TokyoX sample and its analysis; C2 server unavailable during analysis.
Reverse-engineered mutex, beaconing, file-read/exfiltration and remote-shell capabilities.
Privacy-themed fake-software campaign and website/download lure.
Smoke Loader delivery and follow-on malware behaviour at campaign/series level.
RedLine and Raccoon Stealer identified as second-stage payload families.
Attribution is explicitly not made to a named threat group.
Winnti sample detected in January 2020 in a German chemical-company attack context.
German chemical-company compromise known to victim in second half of 2019; duration unclear.
Winnti executable submission detected on 21 February; year not explicit in sentence.
Gravity assessed as likely intended target; compromise not established.
Spear-phishing campaign beginning July 2021 targeting organizations in Pakistan.
One spear-phishing email sent 30 June 2021 at 10:44 PKT with specified subject and lure.
Three similar malicious document samples with matching macro and URL.
Macro payload download/execution and Netwire information-stealing/C2 behaviour.
The source dates creation of the RAMP forum to July 2021.
The source dates a dyadka0220 public post claiming principal Babuk developer status and posting claimed Babuk source code to 3 September 2021.
The source dates the Groove gang's public website response blog to 7 September 2021.
